storage.title: Storage & Auto-scan
storage.description: Folders GodotHub checks at startup. Star a folder to also use it as the default location for new projects/downloads.
storage.projectsEmptyHint: No folders added, nothing will be scanned at startup, and new projects will ask where to save each time.
storage.projectsNote: Scanned at startup for existing projects. The starred folder pre-fills the "Location" field in the New Project dialog.
storage.versionsEmptyHint: No folders added, nothing will be scanned at startup, and new downloads will use the app data folder.
storage.versionsNote: Scanned at startup for installed Godot executables. The starred folder is where new Godot versions are extracted when you install them.
storage.templatesNote: No folder set. You can still import manually or use 'Save as Template'.
storage.templatesImportNote: Any subfolders inside this directory will be imported as templates when you click 'Import from Directory' in the Templates view.
storage.scanDepthNote: How many folders deep to look inside each scan folder above. Lower is faster and avoids picking up unrelated projects/versions buried in nested subfolders; higher digs further if yours are deeply nested.
storage.simultaneousDownloadsNote: How many Godot versions can download at the same time. Extra downloads wait in a queue and start automatically as slots free up.

behavior.title: Behavior
behavior.description: How GodotHub acts when you launch a project.
behavior.closeOnProjectOpenNote: Quits GodotHub automatically as soon as a project is launched in Godot.
behavior.closeOnProjectOpenNoteMac: Hides GodotHub automatically as soon as a project is launched in Godot. It keeps running in the Dock.
behavior.minimizeToTray: Minimize to system tray on closing app
behavior.minimizeToTrayNote: Keeps GodotHub running in the system tray instead of quitting when you close the window. Use the tray icon to reopen or quit.
behavior.reopenAfterGodotClosesNote: Brings GodotHub back out of the system tray automatically once the Godot editor for that project is closed.
behavior.reopenAfterGodotClosesNoteMac: Brings GodotHub back automatically once the Godot editor for that project is closed.
behavior.trayRecentProjectsNote: How many recently opened projects appear in the system tray context menu. Set between 1 and 10.
behavior.projectsDescription: How projects are organized in GodotHub.
behavior.autoScanOnStartupNote: Automatically scans your configured project and version folders for new additions every time GodotHub starts. You can still scan manually anytime from the Projects and Versions views.
behavior.useCategoriesNote: Turns off categories entirely, no Categories button, no category filter, no Uncategorized bucket. Projects shows one plain list. Existing category assignments are kept and come back if you turn this on again.
behavior.useWorkspacesNote: Turns off workspaces entirely, no workspace switcher, no "add workspace" button. GodotHub behaves as if there were only the one currently-active workspace. Existing workspaces are kept and the switcher comes back if you turn this on again.
behavior.tooltipDelayNote: How long to wait before showing tooltips when hovering over buttons, icons, and sidebar items. Lower values feel more responsive; higher values reduce distraction.
behavior.watchersDescription: Automatically detect changes in your scan folders and keep projects, versions, and templates up to date without clicking Sync.
behavior.watchProjectFoldersNote: Automatically scans for new or removed projects whenever files change inside your configured project scan folders. New project folders are added to your library; removed ones are left in place but unregistered.
behavior.watchVersionFoldersNote: Automatically scans for new or removed Godot executables whenever files change inside your configured version scan folders. New executables are added to your installed versions list.
behavior.watchTemplateDirectoryNote: Automatically syncs templates whenever files change inside your template scan directory. Edit a template folder and the template content updates automatically.
behavior.watchersNote: Watchers use debounced file system events. Changes are detected within a few seconds of the last file save. Disabling a watcher frees system resources.

display.title: Last Opened Display
display.description: Controls the "last opened" pill shown on project cards. Hidden entirely for projects that have never been opened.
display.dateFormatLabel: Date format (shown for any other day)

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Changes apply instantly across the whole app.
appearance.backgroundColorNote: Background color applies across all themes. In light mode the app derives card surfaces, borders, and overlays from your chosen background. In dark mode the background sets the base page color.
appearance.cornerRadiusNote: Controls every rounded corner in the app, cards, buttons, inputs, and dropdowns. 0 for sharp, square corners.
appearance.uiDensityNote: Scales padding, margins, and spacing everywhere, lower for a tighter, compact layout.
appearance.textSizeNote: Scales all text (and anything sized relative to it) across the app.
appearance.reduceMotionNote: Minimizes hover and UI transition animations.

advanced.setupWizardNote: Reopens the first-time setup flow where you can reconfigure scan folders, categories, accent color, and corner radius. Settings already saved will be kept, you can always skip steps you don't need to change.
advanced.resetSettingsNote: Restores every setting on this page; download folder, scan folders, appearance and behavior back to their original defaults. Scan folders and download locations are kept; only toggles, sliders, and color picks are reset.
advanced.exportImportNote: Save your current settings as a JSON file to back them up or transfer them to another machine. Importing replaces all current settings with those from the file.
advanced.deleteAppDataNote: Permanently wipes every workspace, project, category, installed-version record, and setting GodotHub has stored. You will be restarted at first-time setup. Your actual project folders and Godot installs on disk are not touched, unless they live in the default download folder.
advanced.checkUpdatesNote: Check if a new version of GodotHub is available. Updates are downloaded and installed automatically, then applied on restart.
advanced.reportBugNote: Help improve GodotHub by reporting issues on GitHub.

confirmReset.title: Reset all settings?
confirmReset.description: This restores every setting on this page, download folder, scan folders, appearance, and behavior, back to their defaults. This can't be undone.

confirmWipe.title: Delete all app data?
confirmWipe.description: This permanently deletes every workspace, project, category, installed-version record, and setting GodotHub has stored, and restarts you at first-time setup. Your actual project folders and Godot installs on disk are not touched, unless they live in the default download folder, in which case they're deleted too. This can't be undone.

welcome.title: Welcome to GodotHub
welcome.description: A home for every Godot project and engine version on this machine. Let's set a few things up so it works the way you want, it only takes a minute, and everything here can be changed later in Settings.
welcome.projectsDesc: Keep every project organized in one place.
welcome.versionsDesc: Download and manage Godot engine builds.
welcome.newsDesc: Stay current with what's new in Godot.

projects.title: Where are your projects?

templates.title: Template projects directory
templates.description: Optionally set a folder where you keep reusable project templates. Any subfolder inside it will be imported as templates on finish, so they show up when you create new projects. You can also save individual projects as templates anytime from the Projects view, or import more later from the Templates tab.
templates.noFolderHint: No folder set, you can always configure this later in Settings, or save templates manually.

categories.title: Organize with categories
categories.description: Categories are folders for your project list, file projects under them however makes sense to you. Add a few starters or make your own; you can rename, reorder, or delete these anytime from Settings.
categories.optionalNote: Nothing here is required, projects with no category simply show up as Uncategorized.

customize.title: Make it yours
customize.description: Pick an accent and background color to start. Corner roundness, density, text size, and light/dark mode are all in Settings whenever you want to fine-tune further.

finish.title: You're all set
finish.description: GodotHub is ready to go. You can revisit any of this, folders, categories, and appearance, from the Settings tab at any time.
